headline: Funds six major parts of the federal government for the 2024 budget year and extends several programs set to expire.
what_it_does: This law provides money through September 30, 2024, for the Defense Department, Homeland Security, Treasury and the IRS, the courts, Labor, Health and Human Services, Education, Congress, and the State Department and foreign aid. It also sets many rules on how that money can and cannot be used and takes back some unspent money from earlier laws, including some IRS enforcement funds. It extends programs such as the National Flood Insurance Program and E-Verify, and it blocks new U.S. payments to the U.N. Relief and Works Agency for Palestinian refugees until March 2025.

who_it_affects.group: Military service members and their families
who_it_affects.how: Funds military pay, health care, and Fisher Houses for families of hospitalized service members, and removes time limits on embryo storage for seriously ill or injured troops.
Funds IRS taxpayer services and the 1-800 help line, bars the IRS from targeting people or groups for their beliefs, and cancels some unspent IRS enforcement money.

who_it_affects.group: People who buy flood insurance through the federal program
who_it_affects.how: The National Flood Insurance Program is extended through September 30, 2024.

who_it_affects.group: Employers who use E-Verify or H-2B temporary foreign workers
who_it_affects.how: E-Verify is extended, and the government may again raise the cap on H-2B visas for temporary non-farm workers, with extra flexibility for seafood businesses.
Their health plans cannot cover abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or danger to the mother's life, and some pay raises for senior political appointees are limited.
They will not receive a cost-of-living pay increase during the 2024 budget year.
The city is funded but still may not use its money to legalize recreational marijuana or pay for most abortions.
Funds Education Department programs and student aid, and requires outreach to borrowers seeking Public Service Loan Forgiveness.

who_it_affects.group: Doctors trained abroad on J-1 visas
who_it_affects.how: The Conrad 30 program, which lets them stay in the U.S. if they work in areas short on doctors, is extended through September 30, 2024.
Federal accident liability protections under the Price-Anderson Act are extended through 2065.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted March 23, 2024; most funding covers the federal budget year ending September 30, 2024.
